import sys
import math

EPS = 1e-8

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def __eq__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Point):
            return abs(self.x - other.x) <= EPS and abs(self.y - other.y) <= EPS
        return False

    def __hash__(self):
        # Not used for set/dict because of tolerance; we keep list for equality checks
        return hash((round(self.x, 9), round(self.y, 9)))

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"({self.x}, {self.y})"

    def distance(self, other):
        return math.hypot(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)

class Circle:
    def __init__(self, center, radius):
        self.center = center
        self.radius = radius

    def intersect(self, other):
        distance = self.center.distance(other.center)
        if distance < EPS:
            return None
        # Line equation from two circles
        A = 2 * (other.center.x - self.center.x)
        B = 2 * (other.center.y - self.center.y)
        C = other.radius * other.radius - self.radius * self.radius + self.center.x * self.center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x + self.center.y * self.center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y
        line = Line(A, B, C)
        return line.intersect(self)

class Line:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c):
        h = math.hypot(a, b)
        self.a = a / h
        self.b = b / h
        self.c = c / h

    def distance(self, point):
        return abs(self.a * point.x + self.b * point.y + self.c)

    def intersect(self, other):
        det = self.b * other.a - self.a * other.b
        if abs(det) < EPS:
            return None
        x = (self.c * other.b - self.b * other.c) / det
        y = (self.a * other.c - self.c * other.a) / det
        return Point(x, y)

    def intersect_circle(self, circle):
        dist = self.distance(circle.center)
        if dist > circle.radius + EPS:
            return []
        # Perpendicular line through circle center
        perp = Line(-self.b, self.a, self.b * circle.center.x - self.a * circle.center.y)
        p = self.intersect(perp)
        if p is None:
            return []
        if abs(dist - circle.radius) < EPS:
            return [p]
        shift = math.sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist)
        return [Point(p.x + shift * self.b, p.y - shift * self.a),
                Point(p.x - shift * self.b, p.y + shift * self.a)]

class UnionFind:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.parent = list(range(n))
        self.rank = [0] * n
        self.count = n

    def find(self, x):
        while self.parent[x] != x:
            self.parent[x] = self.parent[self.parent[x]]
            x = self.parent[x]
        return x

    def union(self, a, b):
        ra, rb = self.find(a), self.find(b)
        if ra == rb:
            return False
        if self.rank[ra] < self.rank[rb]:
            ra, rb = rb, ra
        elif self.rank[ra] == self.rank[rb]:
            self.rank[ra] += 1
        self.parent[rb] = ra
        self.count -= 1
        return True

    def get_count(self):
        return self.count

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    x = [0] * n
    y = [0] * n
    r = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        x[i] = int(next(it))
        y[i] = int(next(it))
        r[i] = int(next(it))

    circles = [Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]) for i in range(n)]

    points = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i):
            intersect_pts = circles[i].intersect(circles[j])
            if intersect_pts is not None:
                points.extend(intersect_pts)

    # Remove duplicates (tolerance-based)
    bad = [False] * len(points)
    for i in range(len(points)):
        for j in range(i):
            if points[i].distance(points[j]) < EPS:
                bad[i] = True
                break

    nVertices = sum(1 for b in bad if not b)
    nEdges = 0
    uf = UnionFind(len(points))
    for i in range(n):
        on_this = []
        for j in range(len(points)):
            if not bad[j] and abs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - r[i]) < EPS:
                on_this.append(j)
        for j in range(1, len(on_this)):
            uf.union(on_this[j], on_this[0])
        nEdges += max(len(on_this), 1)

    nComponents = uf.get_count() - sum(1 for b in bad if b)
    result = 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
